value.title: Plus
value.description:
Boost your social impact, unlock gated experiences, and customize your app theme across the Akita ecosystem.

- Social impact boost
- Core agent access
- Exclusive Plus badge
- Gated staking pools, auctions, and raffles
- Customizable gallery
- Custom app theme
- Higher post upload limits: 15 MB per image, 24 MB post bundles, and up to 128 files per post.

value.title: Pro
value.description:
Enhanced social impact with everything in Plus and Pro-exclusive events.

- Enhanced social impact boost
- Expanded agent access
- Exclusive Pro badge
- Everything in Plus
- Pro-exclusive staking pools, auctions, and raffles
- Higher post upload limits: 15 MB per image, 24 MB post bundles, and up to 128 files per post.

value.title: Ultra
value.description:
Maximum social impact with everything in Pro, Ultra-exclusive events, and early access to new features.

- Maximum social impact boost
- Priority agent access
- Exclusive Ultra badge
- Everything in Pro
- Ultra-exclusive staking pools, auctions, and raffles
- Early access to new features
- Higher post upload limits: 15 MB per image, 24 MB post bundles, and up to 128 files per post.
